SESSION LOG — 'cost' (claude session 6f8df6b5), 2026-08-10 → 2026-08-12. Compaction checkpoint.

== PHASE 1: Gate cost analysis (rounds 1-6, full record: reports/llm-gate-cost-2026-08-11/ + artifact https://claude.ai/code/artifact/725e8b52-688d-49ed-a286-4571bedce34d, ticket childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet b902-18af-14ed-4da1)
- Since Bedrock (08-03): plan-review $3.02/run, code-review $1.42/run, completion $2.24/run; $11.85/ticket-completed; 66% of plan runs are re-reviews.
- Experiments (~$105/$150): Nova Pro verdict-parity 8/8 on real replays but finding-lossy (~50% blocking-criteria recall); Sonnet-as-frontier failed 0/3; Haiku CV 19/22 zero-false-accepts but prompt remediation could not reach parity (keep Sonnet); per-AC split strictly dominated; Nova ceilings landed (change 1597).
- Overlap detection was dead since batching (confidence=0.0 + truncation): REPAIRED + landed (1598), live near-dup 0.95 both orderings.
- Incremental re-review REJECTED by audit (37% of re-reviews block on new criteria; same-material control 0%). Same-material reuse hardening → drift-scoping shipped (1599+1616). Cited-anchor warn-only precheck ticket aeromarine-notorious-gelding signed/claimable (NOT implemented).
- Ordinal migration plan (C11): reports/llm-gate-cost-2026-08-11/ordinal-migration-plan.md. Key data: base-five attrs NEVER decide in plan-review (0/22,503 flips); ladder levels DO carry 4-5.6% decision info (naive binary regresses); code-review corpus EXISTS (earlier no-corpus finding was my script's field-shape bug) and its ordinals are near-inert (≤0.77% collapse flips) → Phase 3 unblocked, low-risk, AWAITING OPERATOR GO. plan-v5 batch (undecomposed+dod kind-sets+margin telemetry, re-score gate, escalate per R1) IN FLIGHT via caribou agent on ticket fixable-angular-caribou.

== PHASE 2: Bug bash (goal: open/in_progress bugs + orphans → 0). 19 changes MERGED (1597-1599,1600-1604,1606-1612,1614,1616,1617,1619 + leech 1607), ~25 tickets resolved.
CLOSED tickets this session: frangible-applicable-snipe, cumbersome-littlish-koalabear, marine-herby-wolf, arachnidan-esophageal-honeybee, earthly-wraithlike-urson, primordial-segregated-oropendula, unthanking-ermined-springbok, milky-guidable-mandrill, chargeable-combustive-leech, emersed-utopic-whiterhino, square-tragic-llama, spinal-grayish-perch, lowcost-unsainted-wallaby, mutinous-conceptual-moorhen, warmthless-dermal-oropendola, prochurch-drowsy-seagull, wormy-camlet-puma, regional-lamproite-flee, kaolinite-head-wildebeest (not_a_bug), cumulative-insensible-asianlion, 3939+e800 earlier. PARKED idea: actinide-possible-scarab, iconic-interested-snake (epic). RETYPED epic: despotic-floriated-leopard (direction encoded, 4 children to create).

IN FLIGHT (agent → ticket → change): leopard→tasty-unappeased-leopard→1624ps2 (AC4 split to eclectic-industrial-argali); jaguar→musophobic-secondary-jaguar→1622 (trigger rename); urutu→syllabic-spiteful-urutu→1618ps2 (awaiting last CI shard); walleye→postwar-bardic-walleye→1623 (blame-scan quiet+bound; 4-digit docs sweep); iguanodon→karmic-balsamic-iguanodon→1615 (repeat -1, mutation-gate-staleness check dispatched); s3doctor-agent→gnarled-acardiac-bettong + wrongful-chemic-squeaker (HEAD bundle fix + retry seam); nandu-agent→abdominal-grieving-nandu (re-scoped to verification_recorded error signal only — premise partly disproven, code-review DOES record verification 97.5%); caribou-agent→fixable-angular-caribou (plan-v5 batch); conure ticket undyed-unheedful-conure closed? (1608 merged; agent was finishing live-eval AC — VERIFY status); yucker→customable-desirable-yucker (guards + existing-channel observability).

OPEN bugs remaining (not yet assigned): royal-weariless-zebrafish (B9: re-measure then fair-queueing approved), shiftable-underage-waterdogs (B5: reproduce first, contract change contingent), vapoury-attack-lamb (B10 approved: MCP push_status + pending marker), tasty AC4 child eclectic-industrial-argali, gold-distinct-lacewing (B7 approved: warn+override re-init, fsck env-id check), hemophobic-vegetarian-mynah (B8 approved: AC2/AC3 only, limb 1 disproven), nonliteral-spangly-fly (ESCALATION 18 pending: data-repair decision on 13 REB-410..422 ZZ-TEST reverse bindings), dogmatic-antiquated-warbler (17a approved: post-run validation), + ops-sweep bugs: ACLI bridge auth expiry (9a71, top signal), reconciler impossible-link churn (b8b1), autodeploy interrupt (7b4a), + flake-cluster discoveries: subjective-forgeable-banteng (xdist hard-crash), sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly (ASSIGNED TO MUTATION SESSION — hands off).

== FLEET PLAYBOOK (for successor): CI -1 signatures: (1) mutation gate failing pre-analysis = change based before 57d19254 → REBASE, never recheck (fix assigned to mutation session); (2) complexity-baseline shallow-clone race, fails pre-pytest → recheck; (3) s3_doctor bad object HEAD transient → recheck + log on wrongful-chemic-squeaker (hardening in flight). Central Gerrit vote monitor: persistent bash Monitor polling status:open changes every 120s, emits READY/-1 transitions; on READY → SendMessage owner to submit (POST /a/changes/N/submit with -d '{}' — empty body 400s); on -1 → dispatch triage. Implementer briefs must include: tests/interfaces tier locally (not just unit), no raw SHA citations (comment-hygiene gate), subject ≤50 chars, worktree venv on PATH, REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION=us-east-1, never --force.
== PENDING OPERATOR ITEMS: Phase-3 code-review ordinal migration go/no-go; nonliteral data-repair (escalation 18); despotic epic children creation.
